Title: TOM: Q: Do not replace until after (multiple) combats

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Setup:
Badger uses Arson or Bum's Rush on her Methuselah's Prey.
(Both are "Do Not Replace Until After Combat" cards)
Prey uses Anson (who is tapped) to block by playing Wake w/ Eve's Freshness.
("Do Not Replace Until After Combat")

Combat Round 1:
Anson maneuvers to long range with his .44
Badger maneuvers back to close with a Fake Out
("Do Not Replace Until After Combat")
Badger strikes with hands, and Claw's to make it aggravated.
Anson shoots for 2 points, and Sideslips the agg damage.
Badger doesn't Press.
Anson uses Boxed In to press for another round.
("Do Not Replace Until After Combat")

Combat Round 2:
No one maneuvers.
Badger plays Form of Mist (superior) to continue the action at +1 stealth.
(or, alternately, Anson playes Psyche (superior) to start another combat
after blows are exchanged).

Q: which cards are replaced at this point?
1. all cards.
2. all combat cards, but not the action nor reaction cards.

Q: In the case of Form of Mist, Anson can still block and play reaction
cards as if untapped (card text on WwEF), so he plays Enhanced Senses
for +1 intercept and re-blocks, right?

If not, can he play another Wakey? (certainly not, IMHO).

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
L. Scott Johnson <sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu> wrote:
>Q: which cards are replaced at this point?
> 1. all cards.

A combat ended, so all "do not replace" cards are replaced, even if Psyche
or something is due to start another combat.

>Q: In the case of Form of Mist, Anson can still block and play reaction
> cards as if untapped (card text on WwEF), so he plays Enhanced Senses
> for +1 intercept and re-blocks, right?

Looks right, but I will check on that.

> If not, can he play another Wakey? (certainly not, IMHO).

The same minion can't play the same reaction card twice during a given
action, so the vampire that Woke the first time couldn't Wake again, right.
